t1_infectado: Two stick figures on a ruined city street: on the left a stick figure runner with an angry face, wide open mouth and grey-green mold patches on its skin, ragged torn clothes; on the right a stick figure clicker whose whole head is swallowed by a bumpy cream and brown fan-shaped fungus cap with a dark gaping slit and no eyes, small curved click sound lines around it.
t2_zona: A tall grey concrete wall with a checkpoint gate, two stick figure soldiers in olive-green uniforms and round olive helmets hold rifles at the gate, a line of tired stick figure civilians in ordinary clothes with backpacks waits in front of them, one soldier holds a small blue test device.
t3_1900: A street of 1900 with a cast iron gas lamp and red brick buildings: a stick figure man in a dark suit, a black bowler hat and a big curly moustache reads a folded newspaper, next to a stick figure woman in a long dark blue dress with a huge feathered hat.
t4_francia: A narrow Paris street of 1794 with half-timbered houses: a stick figure carpenter wearing a red wool cap with a small blue white and red rosette, long striped trousers, a short brown jacket and wooden clogs, carrying a long wooden plank on his shoulder, next to a stick figure aristocrat lady with a tall white powdered wig and a pale pink silk gown.
t5_guilhotina: Distant view of a Paris square with a tall wooden scaffold frame with a slanted blade far away in the middle distance, a big crowd of tiny stick figures around it, cloudy grey sky, buildings on both sides.
